purpose: Identify the minimum durable control, readiness, risk, supervisor and recovery capabilities required by the current PR #89-#93 operational boundary without replaying superseded intermediate version layers.

chain.ancestry_note: PR #88 forked from merge-base 6cf3891d... while current PR #87 later gained two cleanup commits. Current #87 and #88 therefore diverge by 2 commits behind / 30 ahead when comparing #87 head to #88 head. The late #87 instrument formatting fix is present in #88 as the identical blob; the supervisor cleanup is reflected in #88 alongside the required v123 schema-version update. Canonical extraction must use final file semantics/tests rather than assume perfect branch ancestry.

required_capability_slices.name: DURABLE_RUNTIME_AND_AUDIT_FOUNDATION
required_artifacts: v119 single-writer runtime lease without TTL or automatic stale takeover
v119 active excursion checkpoint with CAS semantics
v120 append-only approval authorization
v120 append-only protected-entry provenance
v120 append-only fully reconciled terminal evidence

required_capability_slices.name: CONTROL_AND_SESSION_RISK
required_artifacts: v121 append-only ARM/HALT journal and cryptographic event identity
short-lived ARM with repeated final check before new exposure
v122 immutable opening equity and monotonic high-water session-risk ledger
one-time flat/HALTED session initialization
terminal evidence -> risk commit -> exact checkpoint ACK ordering

required_capability_slices.name: ACTIVE_TRADE_SUPERVISION_AND_CONTROLLED_RECOVERY
required_artifacts: persistent supervisor has no selector/approval/new-entry capability
hard-block entry executor during active-trade management
protection tightening and reduce-only exits only for existing Demo exposure
ambiguous close is never blindly retried
v123 recovery requires exact verified HALT, owner fingerprint, external process-stop evidence and explicit confirmation
recovery never clears active excursion or session-risk state and never ARMs entries

required_capability_slices.name: CONNECTED_IDENTITY_AND_READINESS_PREREQUISITES
required_artifacts: connected Demo read-only account/database reconciliation
GET-only least-privilege metadata proof for the separate trading credential
protected fixed-egress trust zone and IP-binding checks

required_capability_slices.name: FINAL_BOOTSTRAP_AND_ACTIVATION_READINESS
required_artifacts: explicit guarded schema apply/verify
v119-v124 final migration fingerprinting and readiness
SHA-bound fail-closed activation manifest
logical operational database identity verified
required_capability_slices.reason: PR #79 and #83 introduce required semantics, but their intermediate version-specific implementations are superseded by the strengthened v124 bootstrap/readiness forms in PR #93.

required_capability_slices.name: APPROVAL_LINEAGE_PREREQUISITE
required_artifacts: outcome-free immutable approval lineage
exact-symbol approval with no ranked fallback
burned authorization becomes recovery-only after restart/late block
terminal attribution remains diagnostics-only

migration_lineage_to_preserve.purpose: audited runtime lease recovery and control no-TRUNCATE hardening

preserve final equivalent cleanup semantics plus v123 hardening through explicit file-level extraction/tests
